verdict.reason: Dropping R would lower the maximum VIF from 8.74 to 2.49, cost only 0.0029 of in-sample R2, and raise grouped k-fold from 0.4235 to 0.4401. It is retained anyway: acting on that improvement after seeing it is post-hoc specification selection, which is the practice this paper argues against. The dependence is disclosed instead of engineered away.
